summary: Controller system settings (Settings > Automation Execution > System): base URL, Proxy IP allowed list for trusting REMOTE_HOST_HEADERS behind a proxy, Red Hat client ID and secret for analytics and subscriptions, global default execution environment, custom virtualenv paths, analytics gather interval and Remote Host Headers such as HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR.
questions: How do I set the global default execution environment?
